paragraphs.source_en: to make trouble and the very instigator demanded that the principal would punish the boys. Red-shirt, an embodiment of disagreeableness, was much kinder than was expected and indirectly warned me to be on my guard. He was said to have seduced Madonna, and yet he said he would never marry her unless her engagement to Mr. Koga was broken. I thought the man who criticized and drove me out was Ikagin himself, but no sooner had I given up the room than Noda, the Clown, got into it with no scruple. These things made me think nothing on earth was reliable. If I wrote to Kiyo about them, she would be greatly surprised and might say that the place was a den of monsters, as it stood beyond Hakone.
